means.example-sentence: It is generally thought to be rude for a lot of friends to visit a person at short notice.
means.sentence-jp: たくさんの友人が1人の人を急に訪問するのは失礼だと一般には考えられている。

cloze.maskedText: It is generally thought to be rude for a lot of friends to visit a person ____.
cloze.answerBase: at short notice / on short notice

notes: at [on] a moment’s notice とも言う。at [on] two weeks’ notice なら「2週間の予告期間で」。on は米。
